superseded_run.reason: The first successful implementation mapped the frozen minimum_scored_species_per_component=50 to the existing helper's minimum-islands threshold instead of filtering island-component rows to n_species>=50 before modelling. Its H2 p-values are not valid for the frozen v1 contract.

source_factor.interpretation: More than 86% of the variance among the three sampled named floral templates lies on one source-trained shared architecture axis in both evidence scopes.

identity_specific_residual_family.interpretation: The v1 df=3 gate is mathematically incompatible with the residual space produced by subtracting one shared factor from three template dimensions. The rank-2 p-values are recorded as descriptive diagnostics only and do not retroactively repair the frozen v1 test.

shared_architecture_family.reason: The reused PR138 multivariate helper intentionally requires at least two response axes and therefore cannot test a one-dimensional shared factor. This is an implementation-interface limitation, not a biological null.

claim: The frozen v1 specificity test cannot be interpreted as designed: its three residual labels span only a two-dimensional residual subspace, while its shared one-dimensional factor cannot be evaluated by the reused multivariate helper. Correct per-island support leaves adequate North/Tropical sample counts, and the observed rank-2 residual diagnostic is unsupported in both evidence scopes, but a separate post-hoc structural correction is required for a valid formal decomposition test.
